sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Metabolism is a Physical skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Healthy metabolism improves and extends the effects of eating and drinking, and sustains the physical skills longer.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - At Elite level, stamina regeneration is still affected by low energy and hydration levels.

sections.heading: Hideout
sections.text: - Level 3 of this skill is needed for the nutrition unit level 3

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases food and drink positive effects (1% per level → +50% at Elite Level)
- Reduces negative effect time of stimulants, food, water (1% per level → -50% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: You don't receive damage from exhaustion and dehydration

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Replenishing energy and hydration through provisions.
  - The amount of energy or hydration restored determines the number of skill points gained, not the act of consuming a provision.
  - Points are only granted when consuming provisions in-raid. Instead of consuming provisions in your stash, consume them at the beginning of each raid.
  - There is a display bug that shows points gain in stash.
- Completing the quest Never Too Late To Learn
- Completing the quest A Life Lesson

sections.heading: Leveling Guide
sections.text:
Following this guide will result in Max metabolism between 200-500 raids. It will likely be the first skill that you max out.
- As mentioned earlier, always consume Provisions in raid.
- Constantly apply energy or hydration-draining painkillers throughout a raid, then consume provisions before extracting.
  - Ibuprofen painkillers and Golden Star balm are ideal for this because they have many uses. Additionally, if you have Medstation level 3 unlocked in the Hideout, you can craft these painkillers into Propital and sell the Propital on the Flea Market, effectively making this process free.
  - This has the added side effect of allowing you to run if something shoots out your legs, increasing your survivability.
- When you cannot loot provisions due to lack of space, consume them for the skill points. Remember to consume the food first because most food drains hydration points.
- Eat a hydration-draining food like Can of condensed milk, then drink a water bottle at the start of each raid.
  - This is only recommended for short raids. For longer raids, it is likely a waste of money if you employ the above methods.
